title: new electron install fails under arm32
body:

### Electron Version

42.4.0, 40.10.3, 41.7.2, all new versions with new `@electron-internal/extract-zip` installer

### What operating system(s) are you using?

Other Linux

### Operating System Version

debian bookworm

### What arch are you using?

Other (specify below)

### Last Known Working Electron version

42.3.3, 40.10.2, 41.7.1

### Does the issue also appear in Chromium / Google Chrome?

I don't know how to test

### Expected Behavior

`npx install-electron` should install electron binaries

### Actual Behavior

I'm missing install binaries for arm32

```bash
node@5d7b446b0399:~/test$ dpkg --print-architecture
armhf
```

```bash
Node.js v22.22.3
node@5d7b446b0399:~/test$ npx install-electron
file:///home/node/test/node_modules/@electron-internal/extract-zip/binding.js:567
    throw new Error(
          ^

Error: Cannot find native binding. 
```
